<div><strong>Job Description:&nbsp;</strong></div><div><strong>Short Description:</strong></div><div>The Client is looking for Data analyst with 11 years of experience managing data pertaining to the different medical, nutrition, and financial subsidies managed by the Client system.</div><div>&nbsp;</div><div><strong>Complete Description:</strong></div><div>The Data Analyst will play a critical role to support the work of the Client Program Administration, Executive Steering Committee and Client Stakeholders. Under the aegis of the Client Chief Data Officer, the Client Data Analyst is responsible for:</div><div>&nbsp;</div><div><strong>Operational Oversight</strong></div><div>One of the key duties of the Data Analyst s is overseeing the life cycle of a Client data. Specifically, the Data Analyst is responsible for defining and implementing policies and procedures for the day-to-day operational and administrative management of systems and data —including the intake, storage, processing, and transmission of data to internal and external systems. As a part of the oversight for institutional data, the Data Analyst must be accountable to define and document data and terminology in a relevant glossary. This includes ensuring that each critical data element has a clear definition and is still in use.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Responsible for developing and implementing strategies to assess and develop rules to maintain the quality, integrity and reliability of data.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Coordinate cross-agency efforts and decisions that ensure official agency records requirements, privacy, security and other related requirements are met.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Provide oversight to ensure the data issues, needs and requirements are documented.</div><div>&nbsp;</div><div><strong>Data Quality</strong></div><div>This ultimately responsible for establishing data-quality metrics and requirements, including defining the values, ranges, and parameters that are acceptable for each data element. They also work with the Client Data Research, Analytics, and Management team to establish procedures for detection and correction of data-quality issues and collaborate to establish policies, procedures, and internal controls affecting the quality of data. In addition, the Data Analyst engages in the ongoing and detailed evaluation of data quality, the identification of anomalies and discrepancies, and the contribution of expertise to understand the root cause and implement corrective measures.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Coordinate with Client program teams and Client Stakeholder Agencies to ensure the quality and integrity of the Client data elements (both content and metadata) to support the implementation of Client.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Facilitate the creation of data standards based on business rules, data access security requirements, and retention of legacy data.</div><div>&nbsp;</div><div><strong>Privacy, Security, and Risk Management</strong></div><div>One of the most critical aspects for the Data Analyst s is the protection of data. The incumbent must establish guidelines and protocols that govern the proliferation of data to ensure that privacy controls are enforced in all processes. To be effective, the Data Analyst must compile retention, archival, and disposal requirements and ensure compliance with institutional policy and regulations. Accordingly, the Data Analyst will establish and implement data curation practices to ensure that the life span of data is commensurate with requirements. However, the Data Analyst must protect data while striking a balance between transparency and privacy.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Review agency and interagency data-related work products.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Coordinate cross-agency efforts and decisions that ensure official agency records requirements, privacy, security and other related requirements are met for data.</div><div>&nbsp;</div><div><strong>Policies and Procedures</strong></div><div>The Data Analyst defines policies and procedures for access to Client data, including the criteria for authorization based on role and/or the individual. Working closely with Client IT, Privacy and PMO to establish controls, the Data Analyst evaluates any suspected or actual breaches or vulnerabilities in confidentiality, integrity, or availability and report them to management or information security personnel.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Monitor and analyze the application of federal, state and local data requirements, standards and rules (internal and external).</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Coordinate efforts with stakeholder agencies to interpret business needs into applications and derive data requirements that represent the business entities' needs regarding accessibility, completeness, timeliness, desired attributes and relationship to other data entities when appropriate</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Present findings and recommendations to Client leadership, Executive Steering Committee and other stakeholders regarding recommended changes to improve operating practices, accountability, or transparency.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Other duties as assigned.</div><div>&nbsp;</div><div><strong>Other Significant Facts</strong></div><div><strong>Preferred Skills include:</strong></div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Knowledge of good data management principles, concepts and practices;</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Knowledge of how to determine business data requirements, create data standards and business rules;</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Knowledge of human services and health care programs;</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Ability to work with multiple agency stakeholders that may have common and unique agency or program-specific data requirements;</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Familiarity with public policy issues related to human services data requirements;</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Ability to analyze complex, abstract issues in a logical, structured way;</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Excellent written and oral communication skills</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook);</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Knowledge of statistics and/or research methodology.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Analytical skills: outstanding analytical and problem-solving abilities.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Familiarity with business information generation and analysis methods.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Ability to effectively drive business, culture and technology change in a dynamic and complex operating environment.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Gravitas to develop a framework for information and data governance, as well as to sell and embed it in all levels of the business.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain digital concepts and technologies to business leaders, as well as business concepts to technologists; the ability to sell ideas and process internally at all levels, including the board and investors.</div><div>·&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Demonstrated knowledge of data structure desired, but not essential; information systems/tools, and related software and data management; enterprise content management, and record-keeping policies and practices in a complex organizational environment.</div><div>·&nbsp; <h2 class="iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoField_Job">

<div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Text">
<p><span>Bruker is enabling scientists to make breakthrough discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. Bruker’s high performance scientific instruments and high value analytical and diagnostic solutions enable scientists to explore life and materials at molecular, cellular, and microscopic levels. In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity, and customer success in life science molecular and cell biology research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy and nanoanalysis, as well as in industrial applications. <p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 8945 Cal Center Dr, Sacramento, CA 95826, USA
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://golden1.com">http://golden1.com</a>
</p>

<div>TITLE: DevOps Engineer IISTATUS: ExemptREPORTS TO: Mgr - DevOps - SREDEPARTMENT: IT - Infrastructure Systems&nbsp;JOB CODE: 12041
PAY RANGE: $123,600.00 - $135,000.00 Annually
&nbsp;




POSITION AND PURPOSE




The DevOps Engineer 2 is responsible for leading the automation processes for deploying Infrastructure as Code in both Microsoft Azure and On-Premises environments. The engineer will deploy product updates, identify production issues, and implement integrations that meet our customers’ needs. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering, with significant experience in Terraform, Python, and PowerShell. The engineer will lead the infrastructure-as-code process, manage Linux/Kubernetes cluster environments, and support development teams on API integration strategies. The engineer will design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for faster and more reliable software releases. Additionally, the engineer will monitor systems, create alerts, and ensure application uptime and performance. Responsibilities also include provisioning and setting up metrics, creating alerts and managing alert suppression, and proposing automation solutions to reduce workload. This role is responsible for implementing and operating cloud platform services and standards defined by Cloud Engineering, with a focus on reliability, security, and scalability.




WHO WE ARE 




Golden 1 Credit Union is among the top credit unions in the country. As a member-owned, not-for-profit cooperative, Golden 1 is guided by the credit union philosophy of “people helping people.” We are committed to empowering our members and uplifting our communities as we create a more equitable and financially inclusive California. We welcome all who embrace our Core Values.




WHO YOU ARE 




You are an experienced DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering professional who takes ownership of delivering reliable, scalable, and secure platforms in a mission‑critical environment.
You are a hands‑on engineer who designs, implements, and operates automation, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and observability solutions, and who can independently troubleshoot complex issues and drive them to resolution.
You are a collaborative partner who works closely with development teams, cloud engineering, and IT peers, applies standards consistently, mentors junior engineers, and contributes to a culture of reliability, accountability, and continuous improvement.
&nbsp;




THE WORK 




GOLDEN 1 RESPONSIBILITES INCLUDE:

Independently lead infrastructure-as-code development using Terraform and scripting languages such as Python and PowerShell to support scalable and reliable deployments.
Manage Linux/Kubernetes cluster environments.
Deploy solutions in accordance with Change Management Processes.
Support development teams on API integration strategy and standards development.
Ensure systems are secure against cybersecurity threats.
Identify technical problems and develop software updates and fixes.
Strong Splunk skills for administration, query optimization, alerting, and dashboard development.
Build tools to reduce errors and improve customer experience.
Propose ideas and solutions within the Infrastructure Department to reduce workload through automation.
Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for faster and more reliable software releases.
Independently conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
Design and write tests to investigate infrastructure failure and scaling.
Create and maintain response playbooks across incident management and monitoring tools.
Develop automation to ensure repeatability, eliminate toil, and reduce time to action and repair services.
Analyze key operational metrics to identify opportunities to improve availability.
Implement effective monitoring, alerting, and reduction of alert fatigue.
Manage container orchestration environments and optimize deployment workflows to enhance scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
Design, build, and manage containerized environments using Docker.
Create and maintain SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets.
Design and optimize monitoring dashboards and alerting systems to proactively detect and address application performance and uptime issues. 
Implement code branching strategies using GitHub functions.
Advanced Terraform syntax and GitLab CI/CD configuration, pipelines, jobs.
Provisioning and setting up metrics in Prometheus, Thanos, and Grafana, creating and managing alerts.
Implement cloud engineering standards, reusable modules, and platform patterns in Microsoft Azure
Operate shared cloud platform services according to Cloud Engineering defined architectures
Ensure infrastructure changes comply with reliability, security, and cost controls established by Cloud Engineering
Maintain operational documentation and runbooks for cloud platform services

&nbsp;




QUALIFICATIONS




EDUCATION: Bachelor of science degree (or equivalent) in computer science, engineering, or relevant field.
EXPERIENCE: 

Over 4 years as a DevOps Engineer in medium to large-scale environments. 
Proficient in Windows Server, Linux, and hybrid cloud deployments using Microsoft Azure and VMWare. 
Skilled in Git/GitHub workflows, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, and container orchestration (Tanzu, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift). 
Experienced with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps) and observability platforms (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ThousandEyes). 
Knowledgeable in log management (ELK Stack) and database technologies (PostgreSQL, MySQL, NoSQL). 
Strong background in automating infrastructure provisioning and application deployment using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. 
Proficient in creating and maintaining monitoring dashboards, SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets to ensure application uptime and performance. 
Experienced in ensuring infrastructure security, driving automation initiatives, and collaborating across teams to improve reliability and scalability.
Experienced in building observability pipelines and performing advanced queries in log management tools like Splunk for troubleshooting.
Experience implementing and operating Azure-based shared services defined by platform or cloud engineering teams

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS:

Microsoft Azure DevOps Engineer Expert Certification (Required)
Kubernetes Administration Certification (Required)
Linux Certification (Desired)

CORE COMPETENCIES:

Takes Initiative – Owns tasks and responsibilities 
Delivers Results with Agility – Meets deadlines and adapts 
Collaborates Across Teams – Works well within the team solves problems proactively
Handles day-to-day challenges Builds Trust and Credibility – Demonstrates reliability





ORGANIZATIONAL CONTACTS &amp; RELATIONSHIPS




INTERNAL:&nbsp;Regular interaction with Infrastructure Engineers, Computer Operations, IT Programing, Information Security, Network and Storage teams, and IT Service Management staff to support enterprise systems, respond to incidents, and perform scheduled maintenance activities.
EXTERNAL:&nbsp;Interaction with approved technology vendors, hardware and software support providers, and service partners, typically in coordination with IT Systems Manager, for troubleshooting, maintenance, and support escalation.




&nbsp;
&nbsp;
&nbsp;
WORKING CONDITIONS




Work time includes weekend and after-hours time, based on organizational needs. This position works in-office where working conditions, lighting, temperature, audio, and workspace are all sufficient. 




PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS




Work requires the ability to constantly operate a computer and the ability to read, type, and communicate. Work may require the ability to move work-related supplies weighing up to 10-15 pounds.

Because the nature of positions and job functions can change over time, this job description is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all essential functions, duties, responsibilities and qualifications requirements of team members assigned to this job. Job duties may be changed or modified in the Credit Union’s discretion. <div><div><div><h2><b>Job Overview</b></h2> </div><div><p><br>The <strong>Senior InfoSec Engineer (SecDevOps) </strong>is a subject matter expert (SME) who plays a crucial role in bridging the gap between development, operations, and security. Our ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in both IT security and software development, enabling them to implement and maintain secure DevOps practices across our projects. The engineer works as part of a team to assess cybersecurity and technology risk against established frameworks, standards, policies and methodologies. The individual reviews and recommends controls and best practices, and continually evaluates risk exposure and tolerance as defined by business leaders and external entities. The role also reviews and documents deficiencies, advocates for change, and when appropriate, escalates issues to senior risk leadership. With an emphasis on developing secure DevOps strategies, this position plays a crucial role in securing business-to-business initiatives, third-party relationships, outsourced solutions, and vendors. Ideal candidates will possess practical hands-on technology experience with security principles and risk management, along with a strong understanding of DevOps culture and practices.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>This position has been designated as permanently <strong>remote</strong>, work from home located in India.</li>
<li>Must be able to work the hours of 3pm - 11pm IST</li>
<li>May require occasional domestic or international travel.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div></div><div><div><h2><b>Job Description</b></h2> </div><div><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>Develop, implement, and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines to facilitate safe code releases without sacrificing speed or efficiency.</li>
<li>Collaborate with development and operations teams to integrate security at every phase of the software development lifecycle.</li>
<li>Conduct vulnerability assessments and security tests on applications and infrastructure to identify and mitigate risks before production deployment.</li>
<li>Automate security processes to reduce human error and increase incident response times.</li>
<li>Maintain security documentation and standard operating procedures.</li>
<li>Stay up to date with emerging security threats and vulnerabilities and ensure that the company's systems and data are protected against them.</li>
<li>Provide security awareness training to other teams and advocate for security best practices throughout the organization.</li>
<li>Participate in the development and enforcement of security policies and procedures.</li>
<li>Perform other duties as assigned.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><span><strong>QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s degree (B.A./B.S.) or equivalent in computer science, information security, or related discipline.</li>
<li><strong>Experience:</strong> 3+ years of experience in a DevOps role with a strong focus on security, or in a dedicated cybersecurity role with exposure to DevOps practices.</li>
<li>An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted as a satisfactory substitute for the specific education and experience listed above.</li>
<li><strong>Certification/Licensure</strong>: IT security related certification desired (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or similar professional certification).</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span>Other:</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their native security tools.</li>
<li>Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) and automation tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins).</li>
<li>Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).</li>
<li>Knowledge of compliance standards and security frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2).</li>
<li>Experience with secure software development practices such as using SAST/DAST tools, secure code review, and threat modeling.</li>
<li>Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to think critically and strategically.</li>
<li>Effective communication skills, with an ability to convey complex security issues to non-technical stakeholders.</li>
<li>Must have strong interpersonal, teamwork, self-initiative skills.</li>
</ul></div></div></div>
<p><span><span><b>About Corporate Functions&nbsp;</b><br>
The Corporate Functions provide operational support across Charles River in areas such as Human Resources, Finance, IT, Legal, Sales, Quality Assurance, Marketing, and Corporate Development. They partner with their colleagues across the company to develop and drive strategies and to set global standards. The functions are essential to providing a bridge between strategic vision and operational readiness, to ensure ongoing functional innovation and capability improvement.</span></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><span><b>About Charles River</b><br>
Charles River is an early-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market.</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world.&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>At Charles River, we are passionate about our role in improving the quality of people’s lives. Our mission, our excellent science and our strong sense of purpose guide us in all that we do, and we approach each day with the knowledge that our work helps to improve the health and well-being of many across the globe. We have proudly worked on 80% of the drugs approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the past five years.</span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span><span>We’re committed to providing benefits that elevate your quality of life.&nbsp; Based on your position these may include:&nbsp; bonus/incentives based on performance, 401K, paid time off, stock purchase program, Health and wellness coverage, employee and family wellbeing support programs, and work life balance flexibility.</span></span></span></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><span><span>It is unlawful in some states (including Massachusetts) to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>If you are interested in applying to Charles River Laboratories and need special assistance or an accommodation due to a disability to complete any forms or to otherwise participate in the resume submission process, please contact a member of our Human Resources team by sending an e-mail message to crrecruitment_US@crl.com. This contact is for accommodation requests for individuals with disabilities only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>For more information, please visit www.criver.com.</span></span></p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>

      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Canada
</p>

<p>We know applying for jobs is exhausting. Endless text full of buzzwords and requirements you'll never actually use. We'll skip that.</p><p>We're <strong>vvd</strong>. We make tools for storytellers — worldbuilders, writers, creators. Our goal is simple: empower people to create worlds, stories, and experiences that others can get lost in.</p><p>We're still at the beginning of our own story, and we're looking for a few people to help write the next chapters.</p><p>In a moment where "AI creative tools" are pumping out slop on one side and vicious debate on the other, we're choosing a different path: use this technology to empower human creativity and craft, not replace it.</p><p>This isn't going to be easy — but you'll actually shape something real. Something that will reach millions of people. You'll own it end-to-end, in a way that leaves a mark you can point to and say: <em>I built that.</em></p><h3>What a Product Engineer means at vvd</h3><p>A Product Engineer here is a <strong>more technical Design Engineer</strong>.</p><p>You still care deeply about taste, feel, motion, and craft. But you also go further down the stack: data models, APIs, performance, reliability, and the messy systems work needed to ship great product.</p><p>You are also <strong>extremely comfortable with AI tooling</strong>. You use it daily (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) to explore solutions, generate and refine code, debug faster, and ship at a pace that would be hard to match otherwise.</p><h3>What you’ll do</h3><ul><li>Build features end-to-end: product thinking → implementation → launch → iteration.</li><li>Partner tightly with design and engineering to turn ambiguous ideas into shipped product in days, not weeks.</li><li>Own UI craft <em>and</em> the underlying technical decisions that make experiences fast, reliable, and scalable.</li><li>Shape how we build: patterns, primitives, component quality, testing, and internal tooling.</li><li>Use AI tools as a multiplier. You prompt well, iterate quickly, and maintain a high quality bar.</li><li>Communicate directly and clearly. No corporate padding.</li></ul> <h3>What we care about</h3><p>Experience helps, but it’s not a gate. If you’ve built and shipped real things — jobs, side projects, experiments — and you can walk us through what you built, why you built it that way, what broke, and how you solved it, you’re good.</p><p>Ownership matters more than pedigree.</p><h3>Specifically</h3><ul><li>Strong product engineering fundamentals (TypeScript, React, Next.js or similar).</li><li>Enough backend understanding to build features without getting blocked (APIs, auth, data flow, persistence, basic infra concepts).</li><li>Taste. You can feel what’s working and what isn’t — and you can fix it.</li><li>You can go from a rough idea to a polished implementation without waiting for a perfect spec.</li><li>You think in systems: performance, edge cases, instrumentation, maintainability.</li><li>You use AI tools daily to accelerate your work — not as a crutch, but as leverage.</li></ul><h3>Extra pluses</h3><ul><li>Experience with Figma or similar design tools for rapid prototyping.</li><li>You care about accessibility and inclusive UX.</li><li>You’ve built interactions and motion that feel <em>good</em>, not just functional.</li><li>You read fiction, build worlds, or create things for fun.</li></ul> 

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vvd-product-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vvd-product-engineer</a></p>

      <title>Giga Energy: Head of Project Finance</title>
      <region>New York</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Management and Finance</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/5539/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY. Remote, USA.
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://gigaenergy.com">http://gigaenergy.com</a>
</p>

<div class="job__description body"><div><h3><strong>Why join Giga</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>The Pace:</strong> We're building at a speed most companies talk about but never actually operate at. If you've been bored somewhere else, you won't be here.</li>
<li><strong>The Impact</strong>: Every person at Giga touches the work that matters. No layers, no waiting for approval chains. You'll see your fingerprints on what we ship.</li>
<li><strong>The Team:</strong> A team of operators defining the future of AI infrastructure. We recruit A-players from the most innovative companies in the world, and they choose Giga because the work here means more.</li>
<li><strong>The Moment</strong>: AI doesn't run without power, and that's us. Giga is the picks and shovels behind the AI revolution. This industry is about to explode, and you'll be in the room where it's already happening.</li>
</ul></div><div><h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3>
<p>The AI infrastructure buildout is the largest capital deployment cycle since the shale boom. Hundreds of billions of dollars will flow into power and data center assets over the next decade, and the people who build the financing playbooks now will define how this entire industry gets funded. This role sits at the center of that.</p>
<p>As Giga’s <strong>Head of Project Finance</strong>, you will own capital formation for the company. You will build the project finance function from the ground up — the team, the lender relationships, the capital strategy, and the financing playbooks that unlock nine- and ten-figure infrastructure deployments across power generation and data center assets. You will report directly to the CFO, work shoulder-to-shoulder with the CEO, and sit at the table with tier-one lenders, infrastructure funds, and tax equity investors as the principal, not the advisor.</p>
<p>This is not a role for someone looking to run a desk inside an established framework. You are inheriting a blank page. You will define how Giga finances its pipeline, hire the team that executes it, and set the standard for how this generational buildout gets funded.</p>
<p>This role comes with meaningful equity in a company at the inflection point of a generational buildout. If you’ve been waiting for the right moment to step into principal ownership of capital strategy at scale, this is it.</p>
<h3><strong>Where you’ll work</strong></h3>
<p>Remote. NYC Preferred</p>
<h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Own capital formation across the portfolio — </strong>set the financing strategy for Giga’s full pipeline of power and data center assets, determining how each project gets capitalized across debt, tax equity, sponsor equity, and alternative structures.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Lead the project finance function end to end — </strong>from originating lender and investor relationships, to structuring and negotiating facilities, to closing deals, to managing post-close compliance and reporting.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Build and lead the team — </strong>hire, develop, and manage the project finance organization. Define the operating model, the review process, and the bar for financial rigor as the team scales from one to many.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Structure and close financings at scale — </strong>negotiate non-recourse and limited-recourse debt facilities, construction financing, tax equity partnerships, back-leverage, holdco debt, and other structures with institutional lenders, infrastructure funds, and strategic partners.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Serve as Giga’s principal face to the capital markets — </strong>own relationships with tier-one project finance banks, infrastructure funds, tax equity investors, and ratings agencies. Build the institutional credibility that unlocks favorable terms across the portfolio.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Drive deals to close on Giga’s timelines — </strong>lead financial due diligence and lender-facing workstreams, coordinate across legal, engineering, and operations, and hold the pen on the financial narrative from term sheet through funding.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Partner with the CEO and CFO on enterprise capital strategy — </strong>inform decisions on project selection, portfolio construction, capital allocation, and the corporate financing stack that sits above the project level.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Represent the company to the board and investment committees — </strong>translate complex multi-layer financing structures into clear risk-return narratives for the board, external investors, and credit committees on the other side of the table.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Build the internal financial infrastructure — </strong>models, templates, underwriting standards, governance, reporting cadences, and lender compliance systems that scale with deal volume as Giga grows.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>10+ years in project finance, structured finance, or infrastructure finance, </strong>with a clear track record of leading deals from origination through close as the principal or lead banker — not as support.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Proven record of closing large-scale non-recourse and limited-recourse debt facilities </strong>for physical infrastructure assets, including construction-phase financing, at sizes that have materially moved a portfolio.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Deep experience structuring and negotiating across the full capital stack — </strong>senior debt, mezzanine, tax equity, back-leverage, and sponsor equity — with the judgment to know which structure fits which project.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Demonstrated ability to build a function from scratch or rebuild one at inflection, </strong>including hiring and managing a team, setting the operating cadence, and establishing the standards.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Established relationships across institutional lenders, infrastructure funds, and tax equity investors </strong>that you can activate from day one.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Elite modeling fluency — </strong>you can build a project finance model from a blank spreadsheet, sculpt debt against complex cash flows, and defend every assumption in front of a credit committee. You also know when not to be the one in the model.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>Executive presence and narrative skill — </strong>you’re as credible in a board meeting as you are in a credit committee, and you can turn complex structures into clear risk-return stories for any audience.</li>
<li>&nbsp; <strong>High agency and builder’s instinct — </strong>you are energized, not unnerved, by the prospect of writing the playbook rather than following one.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>&nbsp; Direct experience financing power generation, energy, or data center infrastructure assets at scale.</li>
<li>&nbsp; Deep familiarity with ITC/PTC tax credit structures and transferability provisions under the Inflation Reduction Act, including structuring transfer deals with corporate buyers.</li>
<li>&nbsp; Senior background at an infrastructure-focused investment bank (Macquarie, Guggenheim, RBC, MUFG, KeyBanc) or an infrastructure fund (Stonepeak, GIP, Brookfield, IFM).</li>
<li>&nbsp; Experience with equipment-level financing, sale-leaseback structures, or asset-backed lending for industrial or power assets.</li>
<li>&nbsp; Experience leading a capital markets or project finance function inside an operating company, not just advising from the sell-side.</li>
<li>&nbsp; MBA, CFA, or graduate degree in a quantitative field.</li>
<li>&nbsp; Prior experience at a high-growth company during a scaling phase —<strong> </strong>you know what it feels like when the pace of the business outstrips the infrastructure, and you’re energized by that, not overwhelmed.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Benefits&nbsp;</h3>
<ul>
<li>Subsidized health, dental, and vision insurance</li>
<li>Equity (options) in a rapidly growing startup</li>
<li>401(k) with 4% employer match</li>
<li>Unlimited PTO</li>
<li>Parental leave</li>
<li>Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) or Health Savings Account (HSA)</li>
<li>Commuter benefits</li>
<li>Monthly team onsites where all offices come in–person to collaborate</li>
</ul></div><div><h3><strong>Who we hire</strong></h3>
<p>We hire people who thrive in chaos and get sharper under pressure. You don't wait to be told what to do, you spot the gap and fill it. When there's work to be done, you do it. You make decisions with the information you have, move fast, and adjust along the way. We're not looking for perfect; we're looking for people who get things done.</p>
<h3><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer Statement</strong></h3>
<p>Giga Energy is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.&nbsp;Giga Energy complies with all applicable labor laws, including the California Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA) and other relevant state and federal regulations. We provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and encourage applicants who require accommodations during the hiring process to contact us.</p></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/giga-energy-head-of-project-finance">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/giga-energy-head-of-project-finance</a></p>
</description>

<div class="job__description body"><div><p>Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.</p>
<p>Empowering the world starts with living <a href="https://ouraring.com/about-us">our values</a> and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.&nbsp;</p></div><div><p>We are seeking a <strong>Manager, Financial Reporting</strong> to play a critical role in strengthening and scaling the Company’s financial reporting function as the business continues to grow and operational complexity increases. Reporting to the <strong>Senior Manager, Financial Reporting</strong>, this role will support the preparation of high-quality financial statements and disclosures, drive reporting process maturity, and help build a scalable, well-controlled financial reporting environment.</p>
<p>This position will work cross-functionally to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent financial reporting across the organization while supporting audit execution, internal controls, and public-company readiness initiatives.</p>
<h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Lead the end-to-end preparation, drafting, and compilation of quarterly (Form 10-Q) and annual (Form 10-K) financial statements, including complex footnotes, disclosures, and Management’s Discussion and Analysis (MD&amp;A).</li>
<li>Prepare consolidated and standalone financial statements and disclosures to support both global regulatory reporting and local statutory requirements.</li>
<li>Stay abreast of evolving SEC regulations, PCAOB standards, and FASB updates; evaluate their impact and update accounting and financial reporting policies accordingly.</li>
<li>Support the monthly and quarterly close processes, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial reporting that meets accelerated public-company timelines.</li>
<li>Support the consistent application of U.S. GAAP accounting policies across global subsidiaries through technical guidance and structured review.</li>
<li>Review significant contracts, M&amp;A activities, and unique transactions to assess financial reporting, accounting treatment, and SEC disclosure implications.</li>
<li>Act as a primary liaison for external auditors, managing audit deliverables, timelines, and the resolution of complex reporting and disclosure issues.</li>
<li>Strengthen the control environment by identifying and mitigating financial reporting risks through proactive Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) monitoring.</li>
<li>Lead financial reporting process documentation efforts (XBRL tagging review, disclosure checklists), identify control gaps, and support remediation initiatives.</li>
<li>Drive continuous improvement, automation, and standardization in financial reporting workflows to reduce close cycle times.</li>
<li>Support long-term scalability and readiness for public-company reporting requirements, ensuring reporting infrastructure keeps pace with company growth.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Qualifications &amp; Experience</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Education &amp; Certification:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; CPA license required.</li>
<li><strong>Experience:</strong> 7+ years of progressive experience with financial reporting experience at a publicly traded company.</li>
<li><strong>SEC Technical Expertise:</strong> Proven, hands-on experience preparing and reviewing Form 10-K and Form 10-Q filings, with a strong command of SEC rules, regulations, and U.S. GAAP.</li>
<li><strong>Systems &amp; Tools:</strong> Familiarity with modern financial reporting and SEC filing software (e.g., Workiva, ActiveDisclosure) and ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP) is highly preferred.</li>
<li><strong>Execution Skills:</strong> Highly self-directed and accountable, with a proven ability to deliver against strict SEC timelines and competing demands.</li>
<li><strong>Soft Skills:</strong> A collaborative critical thinker who can work effectively across functions and levels, foresee potential reporting obstacles, and propose alternative, compliant approaches.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Benefits&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>At ŌURA, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at ŌURA&nbsp;has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health and add to our benefits!</p>
<p>What we offer:</p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive salary and equity packages</li>
<li>Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources</li>
<li>An ŌURA Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends &amp; family</li>
<li>20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off</li>
<li>Paid sick leave and parental leave</li>
<li>Amazing culture of collaborative and passionate coworkers</li>
</ul>
<p>ŌURA takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.</p>
<ul>
<li>Region 1: $143,000 - $169,000</li>
<li>Region 2: $130,000 - $153,000</li>
<li>Region 3: $117,000 - $138,000</li>
</ul>
<p>A recruiter can determine your zones/tiers based on your US location.</p></div><div><div class="styles--2Kv6p">
<p>Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.</p>
<p>We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.</p>
<p>Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers!<br>We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note:</p>
<ul>
<li>Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards.</li>
<li>We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront.</li>
<li>Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email.</li>
</ul>
<p>Stay cautious and protect your personal details.</p>
<p>To all recruitment agencies: Oura does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Oura employees, or any other organization's location. Oura is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.</p>
</div></div></div>

      <title>Aguru UK Ltd: Senior Full Stack Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>London</state>
      <skills>Debugging, PostgreSQL, React, Testing/Debugging, Artificial Intelligence (AI), AI HW/SW, and AI Agents</skills>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <type>Contract</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/5536/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United Kingdom
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.aguru.ai/">https://www.aguru.ai/</a>
</p>

<h1>Senior Full Stack Engineer</h1>
<p>Location: Remote, EU/UK preferred<br>Team: Engineering<br>Type: Full-time contractor</p>
<p>We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join a small, high-impact engineering team. You will work across the product surface: React front end, NestJS backend, durable execution system, Postgres data layer and proprietary systems for evaluating and managing systems of LLMs. Some of this you may not have done before, but you will apply your transferable skills and experience!</p>
<p>This role suits someone who enjoys a variety of challenges, extending the forefront of what it takes to deliver reliable and trustworthy AI systems, and making those things simple and a joy to use. You will understand product needs, design clean domain models, build reliable components, ship easy-to-use interfaces, and debug distributed execution behaviour when things get interesting.</p>
<h2>What You’ll Work On</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Build product features across our React/Vite frontend, NestJS backend, PostgreSQL data layer, and Temporal-powered worker stack.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Develop new ways to benchmark and optimise LLM use, including error detection and correction and blocking AI-focused security attacks</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Identify where AI can meaningfully improve structured tasks (and not make things worse): extraction, classification, decision support, agentic tool use, document understanding, communication handling, and automation of tedious operational steps.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Design and extend systems to proactively benchmark, monitor, manage and optimise LLM selection, quantify drift in production, and measure cost vs. performance</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Build APIs, data models, and tenant-aware authorization boundaries for workflows, executions, agents, connectors, inbox, dashboards, and configuration.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Create polished interfaces for workflow authoring, execution monitoring, review queues, dashboards, and configuration-heavy SaaS workflows.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Improve reliability through strong testing, runtime visibility, replay-safe changes, and careful debugging across UI, API, database, workers, and external services.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Who We’re Looking For</h2>
<h3>Required Experience</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong ownership of production enterprise systems.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>React experience, especially building complex data-heavy product interfaces</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with multi-tenant, distributed back-ends with mandatory authentication/authorization</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Solid PostgreSQL experience, including schema design, migrations, query performance, transactional thinking, and gated data access.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with durable or asynchronous systems: workflow engines, queues, jobs, event-driven systems, state machines, distributed orchestration.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Comfort debugging complex production behaviour across UI, backend, database, workers, and third-party integration layers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong testing discipline and the ability to choose the right level of test for the risk involved.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Advantageous to have</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Temporal.io experience, or comparable experience with durable workflows and replay-safe execution models.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience designing or maintaining workflow builders, automation platforms, rules engines, low-code tools, or developer-facing DSLs.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience identifying practical AI use cases inside business processes, especially where LLMs complement deterministic workflow logic.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with AI/LLM integrations in production, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, structured outputs, tool use, agent patterns, or provider abstraction.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with security-sensitive backend work: RLS, secure credential storage and tenant isolation</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, or other distributed orchestration systems</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Core Competencies</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Systems thinking: You can reason about frontend state, API contracts, database state, background execution, and external systems as one product.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Product-minded engineering: You care whether a feature meets the product requirements and is also understandable, simple to use, and operationally reliable</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Autonomy and ownership: You can take a loosely defined problem, collaborate to discover the constraints, make good tradeoffs, and ship.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Clear communication: You can explain tradeoffs, document decisions, and collaborate well with product, design, AI, and engineering teammates.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Accountability and integrity: You take responsibility for outcomes, communicate transparently, and uphold high standards in both technical and team-impacting decisions.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Why Join</h2>
<p>You’ll be joining a small, global team building a technically ambitious product at a stage where senior engineers can have a real impact. You will see work move quickly from idea to shipped product, and you will help define the architecture, quality bar, and engineering culture as we grow.</p>
<p>We value curiosity, clear thinking, accountability, and people who enjoy making complex systems feel simple for users.</p>
<p>To apply, please send your CV for the attention of Oleg at hiring@aguru.com with the subject line “Application for Senior Full Stack Engineer”. The application deadline is 30th June 2026.</p>
<p>Aguru is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/aguru-uk-ltd-senior-full-stack-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/aguru-uk-ltd-senior-full-stack-engineer</a></p>
</description>

      <state>London</state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Product</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0018/4614/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Berlin, Germany
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://nearcut.com/">https://nearcut.com/</a>
</p>

<p><em><strong>Please note that you MUST be based in Europe for this position. </strong></em></p>
<p><strong>Location</strong></p>
<p>Europe, fully remote</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The role</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for a proactive Product Manager to help us scale our capacity to solve meaningful client problems. You'll be joining our dynamic product team as one of two full-time PMs working across the entire product, supported by strategic input from our leadership team. You'll have lots of autonomy, responsibility for important product decisions, and collaboration from colleagues when you need it. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to shape product direction in a client-focused, data-driven environment and build things that really change people’s day-to-day lives.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></p>
<p>You'll work closely with colleagues across product, design, marketing and development to ship features which delight beauty and barbering businesses and help them get the most value from our software:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Leading structured discovery</strong> to understand what our clients actually need by combining Intercom feedback, PostHog data, client interviews, and competitor analysis into a clear point of view</li>
<li><strong>De-risking difficult problems</strong> by identifying and executing the cheapest way to get the information we need to have more certainty</li>
<li><strong>Making sure we build the right thing at the right time</strong> by identifying the highest-impact points of focus across our various product areas and articulating why, so we can prioritize with confidence</li>
<li><strong>Creating organized, well-reasoned specs</strong> that give design, development and AI tools the clarity and constraints to move quickly, with tradeoffs and risks made explicit rather than hidden</li>
<li><strong>Keeping things moving</strong> by maintaining momentum across multiple projects at once, holding scope tightly, and preferring working, testable iterations over a perfect plan</li>
<li><strong>Using AI tools thoughtfully</strong> to accelerate your own work and inform product decisions, while recognizing which types of work still require human judgment</li>
<li><strong>Partnering directly with designers and developers</strong> to iterate solutions during development</li>
<li><strong>Measuring what we ship</strong> by defining success metrics upfront, tracking them in PostHog or across other tools, and proactively communicating your findings</li>
<li><strong>Creating efficient processes</strong> and documentation that help the entire team work better</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Your experience</strong></p>
<p><strong>Essential</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You have at least 3 years of directly applicable PM experience with a strong portfolio of complex B2B or SaaS applications</li>
<li>You're highly organized and self-managing, able to structure your own work and prioritize effectively</li>
<li>You are comfortable in technical discussions with developers and familiar with some programming and query languages for the purposes of prototyping and research</li>
<li>You'd rather ship and learn than search for perfect solutions, and you're energized by ambiguity and back yourself to figure things out as you go</li>
<li>You have excellent instincts for finding the highest point of leverage in any given system or problem space</li>
<li>You think in sustainable and scalable systems that accelerate decision-making and development, rather than defining one-off solutions</li>
<li>You’re a whizz at analyzing data and separating the signal from the noise</li>
<li>You have experience collaborating closely with design, marketing and development teams and iterating on solutions during development</li>
<li>You excel at leading discovery work: carrying out user research, competitive analysis, and data analytics to inform product decisions and create actionable insights</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice-to-have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience in booking/scheduling software or tools for service-based businesses</li>
<li>Experience with Figma for design and prototyping, and Posthog for product analytics</li>
<li>Familiarity with reading Ruby on Rails code</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits of our working environment</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><em>High autonomy and responsibility:</em> We’re a small team with a big product and client base, so every individual has lots of independence and scope for impact.</li>
<li><em>Remote-first:</em> We are a remote-first company without an in-person office. We trust our employees to work flexibly and autonomously to efficiently meet business goals.</li>
<li><em>Limited hierarchy</em>: We’re not bothered about titles or seniority. Everyone is a member of the team and valued as an independent individual contributor. You’re supported and autonomous.</li>
<li><em>Flexible working hours</em>: Aside from regular team meetings and availability during the normal workday, we are happy for you to complete your work whenever you’re most productive.</li>
<li><em>Close and supportive team:</em> Although we work remotely, our team is close-knit and colleagues are always there to help one another.</li>
<li><em>Continuous client feedback:</em> Our clients are small business owners who are very grateful to have our support. We are privileged to work closely with them to continue to improve our product and their experience.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em>“Everyone is pulling in the same direction and supports each other. I've never worked for a company that gets so much positive feedback from the clients - we can really see the impact of our work. I also enjoy that fact that we work remotely and can be flexible.”</em></p>
<ul>
<li><em>Nearcut colleague for more than 3 years</em></li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em>“Working at Nearcut is a breath of fresh air! The business is full to the brim of great people who are motivated to improve themselves and the business on the whole, and the entire company is structured to allow individuals to thrive. I haven't looked back since joining!”</em></p>
<ul>
<li><em>Nearcut colleague for more than 1 year</em></li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll get</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>A remote-first, autonomous working environment; one where you’re proactively making and communicating your own decisions; not being told what to do next</li>
<li>The opportunity to significantly impact product direction</li>
<li>Direct access to client feedback and data to measure your impact</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Plus… the nitty gritty</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>An annual salary of between £60,000 - £70,000</li>
<li>33 flexible holiday days per year. Since our remote-first team is based all over the world, you can choose whether or not to take time off on your country’s public holidays.</li>
<li>A Macbook Pro</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We’re a small team and we’re passionate about being a great company to work with and work for.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Please answer the following key questions in order to apply! The deadline is Sunday June 28th at 11pm GMT.</p>

</description>

      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/5532/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Canada
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://indigenousclimateaction.com">http://indigenousclimateaction.com</a>
</p>

<p><span>Request for Proposal: Website Redesign &amp; Development&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>June 4, 2026</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Introduction</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Indigenous Climate Action (ICA) is seeking proposals from qualified web designers and developers to redesign and develop our organizational website.</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>ICA is an Indigenous-led climate justice organization that works to build Indigenous climate leadership through community-based education, relationship building, and movement support. Our work centres Indigenous rights, sovereignty, land-based knowledge systems, and climate justice across Turtle Island.</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>The new website will serve as ICA’s primary digital platform for storytelling, education, campaigns, research, fundraising, and community engagement. The redesigned platform should reflect ICA’s organizational values, strengthen accessibility and usability, and support long-term growth and sustainability.</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>We are seeking a web development partner capable of delivering:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>A redesigned and accessible organizational website</span></li>
<li><span>Improved site architecture and user experience</span></li>
<li><span>A flexible and maintainable content management system</span></li>
<li><span>Migration and retention of existing content and resources</span></li>
<li><span>Technical documentation and staff training</span></li>
<li><span>Ongoing maintenance and support options post-launch</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Project Objectives</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>The objectives of this project are to:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Refresh and strengthen ICA’s digital presence</span></li>
<li><span>Improve accessibility, navigation, and user experience</span></li>
<li><span>Better communicate ICA’s mission, programs, campaigns, and impact</span></li>
<li><span>Support multiple audiences, including Indigenous communities, youth, partners, funders, media, and the public</span></li>
<li><span>Create a scalable infrastructure that can grow alongside ICA’s evolving work</span></li>
<li><span>Improve internal staff capacity to manage and update website content</span></li>
<li><span>Ensure the website aligns with accessibility, security, and performance best practices</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Scope of Work</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>The selected vendor will be responsible for the following:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Discovery &amp; Planning</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Conduct meetings with ICA staff and key stakeholders</span></li>
<li><span>Review existing website structure and digital assets</span></li>
<li><span>Assess audience needs and user journeys</span></li>
<li><span>Provide recommendations for site architecture and platform improvements</span></li>
<li><span>Identify opportunities for improved accessibility, storytelling, and engagement</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Website Design &amp; Development</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>The scope of work includes:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Information architecture and sitemap development</span></li>
<li><span>User experience (UX) and user interface (UI) design</span></li>
<li><span>Responsive website development across desktop and mobile devices</span></li>
<li><span>Development using a flexible and maintainable CMS</span></li>
<li><span>Template creation for key page types</span></li>
<li><span>Integration of ICA branding and visual identity</span></li>
<li><span>SEO and performance optimization</span></li>
<li><span>Analytics integration</span></li>
<li><span>Accessibility compliance implementation</span></li>
<li><span>Security implementation and best practices</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>The website must be designed to:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Clearly communicate ICA’s mission, values, and programs</span></li>
<li><span>Support storytelling, campaigns, fundraising, reports, and educational resources</span></li>
<li><span>Enable internal staff to efficiently manage and update content</span></li>
<li><span>Support future expansion and evolving organizational needs</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Content Migration &amp; Retention</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>ICA currently operates on Squarespace and intends to retain and migrate select existing content into the new website.</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>This includes:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Existing blog content</span></li>
<li><span>Reports and publications</span></li>
<li><span>Organizational resources and archives</span></li>
<li><span>Selected campaign and program pages</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Vendors should outline:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Their proposed approach to content migration from Squarespace</span></li>
<li><span>Strategies for preserving SEO and existing URLs where possible</span></li>
<li><span>Recommendations for organizing archived and retained content</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Accessibility Requirements&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Accessibility is a core priority for ICA.</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>The selected vendor must ensure:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards</span></li>
<li><span>Accessible navigation and content structures</span></li>
<li><span>Screen reader compatibility</span></li>
<li><span>Appropriate colour contrast and typography practices</span></li>
<li><span>Accessibility testing across devices and browsers</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Vendors should describe:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Their accessibility approach and testing process</span></li>
<li><span>Previous experience building accessible websites</span></li>
<li><span>Tools and methods used for accessibility auditing</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Security &amp; Technical Requirements&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>The selected vendor must implement security best practices appropriate for a public-facing organizational website.</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Proposals should address:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Website hosting recommendations</span></li>
<li><span>Security infrastructure and protections</span></li>
<li><span>Backup and recovery processes</span></li>
<li><span>CMS and plugin maintenance considerations</span></li>
<li><span>Performance optimization</span></li>
<li><span>Long-term sustainability of the technical framework</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Post-Launch Support &amp; Maintenance</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Vendors should clearly outline what ongoing technical support and maintenance would look like after launch.</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>This should include:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Length and scope of post-launch support</span></li>
<li><span>Response times for technical issues</span></li>
<li><span>CMS and plugin updates</span></li>
<li><span>Security monitoring and maintenance</span></li>
<li><span>Bug fixes and troubleshooting</span></li>
<li><span>Options for long-term maintenance retainers or support agreements</span></li>
<li><span>Staff training and documentation</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Project Timeline (Tentative)</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Discovery &amp; Planning: July 2026</span></li>
<li><span>Design Phase: July to August 2026</span></li>
<li><span>Development Phase: August to September 2026</span></li>
<li><span>Testing &amp; Revisions: September 2026</span></li>
<li><span>Launch: October 2026</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Proposal Requirements</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Proposals should include:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ol>
<li><span>Overview of the vendor/team and relevant experience</span></li>
<li><span>Examples of similar website projects</span></li>
<li><span>Proposed approach and methodology</span></li>
<li><span>Proposed CMS and technical framework</span></li>
<li><span>Accessibility and security approach</span></li>
<li><span>Content migration strategy</span></li>
<li><span>Proposed timeline and milestones</span></li>
<li><span>Detailed budget breakdown</span></li>
<li><span>Post-launch support and maintenance options</span></li>
<li><span>Team composition and roles</span></li>
</ol>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Proposal Evaluation</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Proposals will be evaluated based on:</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Alignment with ICA’s organizational values and goals</span></li>
<li><span>Experience working with Indigenous organizations, nonprofits, or mission-driven organizations</span></li>
<li><span>Quality and relevance of previous work</span></li>
<li><span>Accessibility and technical expertise</span></li>
<li><span>Scalability and sustainability of proposed solutions</span></li>
<li><span>Budget and overall value</span></li>
<li><span>Post-launch support capacity</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Additional Terms</span></p>
<p><br></p>
<ul>
<li><span>ICA reserves the right to accept or reject any or all proposals</span></li>
<li><span>ICA is not obligated to award a contract</span></li>
<li><span>All intellectual property created specifically for this project will belong to ICA</span></li>
<li><span>Vendors are responsible for all proposal preparation costs</span></li>
<li><span>Proposals will be treated as confidential</span></li>
</ul>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>Qualified persons of Indigenous Ancestry will be given preference in accordance with s.16(1) of the Canadian Human Rights Act.</span></p>
<p><span>We thank all applicants for their interest in the project. We will only contact those selected for an interview.</span></p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><span>Deadline to Submit&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>July 1, 2026</span></p>

<div class="job__description body"><div><p><strong>About Renaissance</strong></p>
<p>When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre-K–12 education technology! Renaissance’s solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters—creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide.</p>
<p>Every day, we are connected to our mission by exemplifying our values: trust each other, win together, strive for the best, own our actions, and grow and evolve.</p></div><div><h4 class="title">Job Description</h4>
<p>The Account Manager II is responsible for managing and selling Renaissance Learning’s products and services, within assigned territory, and achievement of revenue goals through prospecting, new business, customer renewals, cross-sell, and up-sell opportunities. &nbsp;</p>
<p>The Account Manager II has meaningful sales experience and brings developing expertise for cultivation and long-term development of customer relationships, maintaining high product renewal rates and strong collaboration with Customer Success partners and members of the Account Executive team. You will operate are the primary account contact for customers, increasing customer loyalty and retention while driving business value and expansion.&nbsp;</p>
<p><em>This position requires occasional travel for customer engagements, conferences, and other revenue-generating activities. We are ideally needing someone in the state of Louisiana.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p><strong><span>In this role as Account Manager II, you will be responsible for: </span></strong><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Managing Opportunities: Drive new business, cross/up-sell and renewal opportunities proactively by engaging multiple decision makers to ensure communication and agreement through the life of the opportunity and use internal and external networks to increase opportunity value. Grow assigned book of business to exceed revenue goals. </span></li>
<li><span>Consultative Solution Selling: Understand and sell solutions aligned to customers’ unique problems and strategic objectives. Leads across the account team, internal, and external partners to develop winning solutions bringing value for both the customer and Renaissance. </span></li>
<li><span>Closing Business: Understand and sell solutions aligned to customers’ unique problems and strategic objectives. Leads across the account team, internal, and external partners to develop winning solutions bringing value for both the customer and Renaissance. </span></li>
<li><span>K-12 Education Acuity: Possesses a deep knowledge of the K-12 education space including public, private, and parochial schools. Strong understanding of K-12 districts and school administrative roles, funding, purchasing process, buying cycles, policies, practices, trends, and school board oversight. Knows customer workflows, contacts, and how they integrate into decision-making processes. </span></li>
<li><span>Domain Expertise: Possess strong technical knowledge of common tools and trends in ed tech space; staying current on probable future state policies, practices, and information affecting customer businesses. Knows the competition and how strategies and tactics work in the marketplace. </span></li>
<li><span>Credibility: Builds rapport based on factual accuracy, expertise across offerings, delivering on expectations and proactively providing market insights that inspire customers to think of Renaissance as a partner</span></li>
</ul>
<div>
<h4 class="title">Qualifications</h4>
</div>
<div class="wysiwyg">

</div>
<ul>

<li><span class="TextRun SCXW154542580 BCX0" lang="EN"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW154542580 BCX0">Demonstrated capacity for resourcefulness and creative problem-solving </span></span><span class="EOP SCXW154542580 BCX0">&nbsp;</span></li>

<p>Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.</p>
<p>This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater</strong></p>
<p>In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.</p>
<p>Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.</p>
<p>You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.</p>
<p>You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.</li>
<li>Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.</li>
<li>Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.</li>
<li>Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.</li>
<li>Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.</li>
<li>Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.</li>
<li>Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>The hourly earnings for this role are 20.60 EUR per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.</p>
<h4 class="sui-font-heading sui-text-h2 tw-font-bold sui-text-darkGray-darker tw-mb-1">Qualification path</h4>
<p class="sui-text-b3 sui-text-darkGray-darker ql-editor">&nbsp;</p>
<p>Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Basic Requirements</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in German &amp; English.</li>
<li>Resident in Germany for the last 5 consecutive years.</li>
<li>Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.</li>
<li>Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.</li>
<li>Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.</li>
<li>Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.</li>
<li>Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification</li>
<li>Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.</li>
<li>High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.</li>
<li>Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.</li>
<li>Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.</li>
<li>Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.</li>
</ul>

At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.</p>

Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.</span><span> </span></p><p></p><p>Find your future at Revvity&nbsp;</p><p></p><p><b>Role summary</b></p><p>We are looking for a hands-on Principal DevOps Engineer to lead the design and implementation of our next-generation CI/CD architecture for platform-based product development. <p>
