    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://runware.ai">http://runware.ai</a>
</p>

<strong>Description</strong><br><p>Runware is building the API layer for the next generation of AI products. Our platform gives teams fast, reliable access to real-time inference across thousands of models through a single flexible API. We help customers build and scale media generation products with better performance, lower cost, and less operational complexity.</p><p>Behind this is an infrastructure platform built for speed, reliability, and GPU scale. New models launch constantly. Customer traffic can grow quickly. Performance matters at every layer.</p><p>We are looking for a Staff/Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate, and scale the infrastructure behind Runware’s global AI inference platform. You’ll play a critical role in making our systems faster, more resilient, easier to operate, and ready for the next stage of growth.</p><p></p><h3>About the role</h3><p>Runware’s infrastructure is the engine behind some of the fastest-growing AI products in the world. As a Staff/Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll help design, build, and operate the systems that power real-time AI inference across large-scale GPU fleets and a global production platform.</p><p>This is not a traditional DevOps role. You’ll be working at the intersection of bare-metal infrastructure, GPUs, networking, automation, observability, and high-performance distributed systems. Your work will directly shape how quickly we can launch new models, scale customer traffic, recover from failures, and deliver low-latency AI experiences to millions of users.</p><p>You’ll turn complex, hardware-driven infrastructure into reliable, automated, developer-friendly platforms. From provisioning and orchestration to deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and capacity scaling, you’ll help remove friction so engineering teams can move faster without compromising reliability.</p><p>You’ll build the foundations that let Runware scale with confidence: infrastructure that is fast, resilient, observable, secure, and built for the demands of real-time AI.</p><h3>What you’ll do</h3><ul><li>Build and scale the infrastructure that powers real-time AI inference across GPU fleets, bare-metal servers, serverless and containerised production systems</li><li>Help evolve Runware’s platform toward more elastic, on-demand infrastructure that can scale quickly with customer traffic and model demand</li><li>Make Runware faster, more reliable and more resilient by improving the critical paths behind our request entrypoints, inference services, queues, storage, load balancers and networking layer</li><li>Automate the hard parts of infrastructure operations, from provisioning and configuration through to CI/CD, deployment safety, progressive rollouts and rapid rollback</li><li>Build the observability backbone for a high-performance AI platform, with the signals needed to spot issues early, understand capacity and fix problems before customers feel them</li><li>Play a leading role in production operations, incident response, debugging and post-incident improvements, helping us turn operational challenges into a stronger platform</li><li>Strengthen the security and compliance foundations of our infrastructure through patching, secrets management, access controls, hardening, auditability, documentation and repeatable operational processes</li></ul><br><br><strong>Requirements</strong><br><ul><li>Strong experience as a DevOps Engineer, SRE, Infrastructure Engineer, Platform Engineer or similar, with a track record of running production systems at scale</li><li>Deep Linux knowledge and confidence debugging real production issues across networking, storage, performance, services and system behaviour</li><li>Hands-on experience building automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows that make infrastructure safer and easier to operate</li><li>Experience operating high-availability, low-latency or high-throughput platforms where reliability and performance directly affect customers</li><li>Strong networking fundamentals across TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, routing, firewalls, proxies, TLS and HTTP</li><li>A calm and pragmatic approach under pressure, with strong communication, good judgement and a bias toward automation over manual toil</li></ul><h3>Bonus</h3><ul><li>Experience operating GPU infrastructure for AI/ML inference, including NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, container runtimes, GPU monitoring, capacity planning and workload isolation</li><li>Familiarity with inference serving and optimisation frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT, Triton or similar</li></ul><br><br><strong>Benefits</strong><br><p>We’re a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm, celebrate wins, and enjoy some face-to-face time. We have core hours for cooperative working and calls, but outside of that your calendar is yours. Work the hours that let you perform at your peak while also building a healthy life.</p><p>Our release cycles are fast and intense, but they’re followed by real downtime. After big pushes we expect the team to unplug, recharge, and come back ready &amp; stronger than ever for the next leap.</p><ul><li> <strong>Generous paid time off</strong>&nbsp;– vacation, sick days, public holidays</li><li> <strong>Meaningful stock options</strong>&nbsp;– share in the upside you create</li><li> <strong>Remote-first setup</strong>&nbsp;– work from home anywhere we can employ you</li><li> <strong>Flexible hours</strong>&nbsp;– own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks</li><li> <strong>Family leave</strong>&nbsp;– paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time</li><li> <strong>Company retreats</strong>&nbsp;– twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations</li></ul><p></p>

<p><strong>Specifically, what you will do</strong></p>
<p>You will build amazing things using MongoDB, Next.js, Nest.js, and Node.js, alongside DevOps tools and practices. <div><p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p></p>The Successful Market Director:<br>•	Grows his/her market by attracting high quality, diverse talent into financial professional (FP) roles<br>•	Ensures new FPs are given the tools, resources and knowledge needed in order to be successful in their new role.<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</p><p></p><p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p></p><p><span><b><b>Attract, Recruit and Select Diverse Talent</b></b></span></p><ul><li>Create and implement a recruiting strategy to grow capacity by attracting and cultivating quality, diverse FP candidates in focus market.</li><li>Execute a plan to recruit quality talent by spending focused time developing trusting&nbsp; relationships within broad and diverse networks, leveraging centers of influence and obtaining referrals from FPs for quality, diverse talent</li><li>Partner with other Thrivent leaders/key stakeholders to develop capacity plan and understand recruiting and selection systems.</li><li>Actively manage a pipeline of high quality, diverse candidates,</li><li>Conduct selection interviews and assess candidates for high probability for success.</li><li>Create followership by demonstrating enthusiasm for the career and for Thrivent and by caring about the success of others.</li></ul><p></p><p><span><b><b>Develop New FPs and Support the Launch of New FP Practices</b></b></span></p><ul><li>Demonstrate mastery of the Thrivent Financial Advice Process and be able to model and coach on all elements.</li><li>Conduct high levels of joint field work (approx 3 days per week) as scheduled by new FPs to observe and offer feedback, and help with case prep as needed.</li><li>Demonstrate, model and coach on the use of Salesforce and other Thrivent tools (i.e. CAP, Illustrations, etc.) during the sales process.</li><li>Be available to FPs to develop their goals and conduct meetings with new FPs to discuss progress toward their goals, analyze what’s working and not working and ways to overcome challenges and issues.</li><li>Be available to FPs to develop/execute a marketing plan to achieve their goals that leverage relationships within their natural market, referrals and communities.</li></ul><p></p><p><span><b>&nbsp;Collaborate with Others</b></span></p><ul><li>Inform and communicate with leadership team regarding FP (new and vet) progress toward goals and success.</li><li>Facilitate connections between new FPs and vet FPs to provide additional joint field work experiences or practice experiences for new FPs</li><li>Connect with corporate resources to stay informed of best practices or changes that directly impact recruiting, launch and vets</li><li>Demonstrate ability to use technology effectively with FPs to assist in coaching and training</li><li>Build a plan with the Community Engagement team and others to develop and implement a plan to grow the market, and identify communities or congregations within the market on which to focus, using generosity and other marketing programs.</li><li>Build and maintain relationships with leaders within the Christian Community and centers of influence.</li></ul><p></p><p><span><b><b>Manages Market</b></b></span></p><ul><li>Engages in business planning to set strategy for market and to determine how to meet goals</li><li>Provides leadership and coaching to market team</li><li>Develops a healthy culture within the market, enabling good results and ensuring a culture of excellence in the market</li><li>Work with the Community Engagement team and others to develop and implement a growth plan, and identify key markets on which to focus.</li><li>Build and maintain relationships with leaders within the Christian Community and centers of influence.</li></ul><p></p><h2><b>Characteristics of Ideal Candidate</b></h2><ul><li>Drives for Results: strives for success, and takes ownership of market’s performance</li><li>Passionate about Attracting and Developing&nbsp; Others; gains professional satisfaction from the success of others and being a source of help</li><li>Adaptable: flexible, agile and amenable</li><li>Courageous: willingness to take risks and do what needs to be done to grow individuals and the market</li><li>Credible: Seen as an expert in what it takes to be a successful FP, both in sales process/methods and systems/technology</li></ul><p></p><p><b><b>Minimum Requirements:</b></b></p><ul><li>Demonstrated track record of solid sales results (i.e. L/H/A, investments, etc).</li><li>Experience in using the Thrivent Financial Advice Process, Salesforce and other Thrivent tools and systems (i.e. CAP, Illustrations, etc.) and ability and willingness to model, promote and demonstrate usage of tools as needed.</li><li>Previous experience in attracting others.</li><li>Will and skill to commit to joint field work expectations.</li><li>Experience in leading groups, specifically in presenting and facilitating in order to drive understanding of concepts and practices that lead to new FP success.</li><li>Licensing:<ul><li>FINRA Series 7, 63/65 or 66 required or obtained within 90 days.</li><li>State insurance licensed and appointed in life, health and variable lines of authority or attained within 90 days.</li><li>State securities registered and insurance licensed and appointed in all states that comprise the Advisor Group.</li><li>Once FPs are assigned to this position, this position will require securities registrations, state insurance licenses and appointments in all states where FPs are conducting business and receiving commissions.</li></ul></li><li>Satisfactory background check and clean compliance record.</li><li>Flexibility to travel within the Advisor Group (may include overnight) and conduct business during evening hours.</li><li>Must have own automobile to use for business purposes.</li><li><span>Demonstrated track record of satisfactory performance.</span></li></ul><p></p><p><b><b>Strongly Preferred:</b></b></p><ul><li>Four year college degree strongly preferred.</li><li>Professional designation or history of significant progress toward achievement preferred.</li></ul><p></p><p><b><b>Key Dependencies and Relationships:</b></b></p><ul><li>Advisor Group Leadership Team; vet FPs; new FPs; Advisor Group staff; corporate recruiting, launch and practice management teams.</li></ul><p></p><p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</p>Pay Transparency<p><br>&nbsp;<br></p>Thrivent’s long-term growth depends We accomplish this by offering a wide variety of market competitive compensation programs to attract, reward, and retain top talent.       <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/5507/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> North Carolina
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://brighthousefinancial.com">http://brighthousefinancial.com</a>
</p>

<div class="externalPosting">
<p><strong>Where you’ll work:</strong></p>
<p>Our flexible, hybrid work model offers the option to work remotely or in the office.</p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><strong>How you’ll contribute: </strong></p>
<p>This position will be a key member of the Annuity Modeling team. The Annuity Modeling team is responsible for developing and testing Prophet models for new and current annuity products.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>This position will be responsible for Prophet modeling and development for the FA/FIA Prophet model. There will also be opportunities to work on projects that affect the department more broadly, such as Prophet Enterprise usage and Assumptions Management.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>In this role, you’ll get to:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>This role may have the opportunity to manage other students as an introduction to management</li>
<li>This role will be responsible for the projects and timelines for the FA &amp; FIA Prophet model. Involvement encompasses creating and building, updating, enhancing, running, and validating the model.</li>
<li>Analysis of model results, including: reconciliation and attribution of changes, communication of results to management, and detailed documentation</li>
<li>Implement and test new software releases, library updates, new products, new regulatory requirements, and shared table changes in the Prophet environment</li>
<li>Optimize models to follow coding standards and improve performance</li>
<li>Evaluate new features and modeling approaches for use in our models</li>
<li>Stage model inputs using Data Conversion Systems (DCS) and Assumption Manager</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>We’re looking for people who have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>ASA or near ASA preferred but not required&nbsp;</li>
<li>Currently pursuing an ASA or FSA designation with the Society of Actuaries</li>
<li>Strong computing and programming skills</li>
<li>Strong actuarial and financial skills</li>
<li>Strong communication skills</li>
<li>Can adjust work resources and deadlines in response to changing business priorities&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Research shows some people may not apply for a role if they don’t check all the boxes of a job description. If you don’t check every box listed, that’s okay. We would love to hear from you.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll receive:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Compensation –<em>&nbsp;</em></strong>Base salary ranging from $100,000 - $125,000 plus competitive performance-based incentives determined by company and individual results.</li>
<li><strong>Flexible Work Environment –<em>&nbsp;</em></strong>Work remotely or in the office to better thrive in all areas of life.</li>
<li><strong>Paid Time Off –</strong> Recharge with a minimum of 20 days of paid time off and 16 paid company holidays per calendar year plus paid volunteer time and paid study time.</li>
<li><strong>Financial Health –&nbsp;</strong>Work toward achieving your financial goals through our<strong> </strong>401(k) savings plan with company match (up to 6%) and annual company nondiscretionary contribution (3%), and financial counseling services.</li>
<li><strong>Health and Wellness –&nbsp;</strong>Enjoy competitive medical, vision, and dental plans plus tax-free health savings accounts with potential company contributions up to $1,000 per family.</li>
<li><strong>Family Support –<em>&nbsp;</em></strong>Care for loved ones with up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents, back-up dependent care, dependent care flexible spending account, and up to a $25,000 lifetime maximum during your adoption, infertility, or surrogacy journey.</li>
<li><strong>Life and Disability Support –</strong> Gain access to company-paid basic life insurance and short-term disability insurance.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>The company and your department may occasionally gather in person throughout the year to foster a culture of belonging and promote team building. We’d love for you to join us during those company-wide and department-wide events to help you strengthen connections across the company.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Why join us?</strong></p>
<p>Brighthouse Financial is on a mission to help people achieve financial security. Our company is one of the largest providers of annuities and life insurance in the U.S.,* and we specialize in products designed to help people protect what they’ve earned and ensure it lasts.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We empower employees to collaborate, bring their passion to work, and make an impact. Our inclusive work environment fosters a culture that celebrates diverse backgrounds and experiences. You can find out more about our company culture by visiting brighthousefinancial.com/about-us/careers/.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We’re one of the largest providers of annuities and life insurance in the U.S.,* and our commitment to being a great place to work has earned us recognition as one of America’s Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek and, locally, one of the Healthiest Employers of Greater Charlotte.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>*Ranked by 2024 admitted assets. Best’s Review®: Top 200 U.S. Life/Health Insurers. AM Best, 2025.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Canada
</p>

<h2><strong>About </strong><a href="http://Super.com"><strong>Super.com</strong></a></h2><p>We started <a href="http://Super.com">Super.com</a> to help maximize lives–both the lives of our customers and the lives of our team – so that everyone can experience all that life has to offer. For our employees, our promise is that <a href="http://Super.com">Super.com</a> is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to unlock one’s potential, where learning is celebrated and impact is realized.</p><p>We are more than a fast-paced, high-growth tech company; we care about our people and take career progression seriously. This is your career and our aim is to supercharge it through the people, the work, and the programs that fuel who we are.</p><p></p><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2><p>We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to define how we position, launch, and scale the <a href="http://Super.com">Super.com</a> product portfolio across our membership, fintech, earnings, and travel offerings. Reporting directly to the SVP of Product &amp; Design, this role sits at the intersection of product, design, data, and growth. You’ll own the story of why <a href="http://Super.com">Super.com</a> matters, translating complex products into simple, differentiated narratives that drive adoption, engagement, and retention. If you’re excited by 0‑1 bets, scaling proven products, and building a cohesive portfolio story in a fast-moving environment, this role gives you outsized ownership and visibility.</p><p></p><h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2><p>The Product &amp; Design organization shapes end-to-end product experiences across our core surfaces, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, Brand, and Growth. We are a highly collaborative, data-informed team that works through Mission Aligned Teams (MATs) across Fintech, Earnings, Travel, and our Incubation Hub. We move quickly, test rigorously, and care deeply about quality—from the strategy and positioning down to the last piece of product copy. You’ll join a team that values clear narratives, sharp positioning, and tight product–market–message fit, and that expects Product Marketing to be a strategic partner, not a service function.</p><p></p><h2><strong>What you’ll be working on:</strong></h2><ul><li><p>Own product positioning and messaging for key <a href="http://Super.com">Super.com</a> offerings (e.g., membership, card, earnings, travel), ensuring they are clear, differentiated, and customer-backed.</p></li><li><p>Build and execute go‑to‑market plans for new products, features, and experiments, partnering with GMs, Product, Design, Data, and Growth to drive adoption and revenue.</p></li><li><p>Develop and maintain a cohesive portfolio narrative that ties together our products into a clear, compelling member value proposition across surfaces and channels.</p></li><li><p>Lead customer, competitive, and market insights work to inform product strategy, positioning, pricing/packaging, and roadmap decisions.</p></li><li><p>Partner with Lifecycle/CRM, Performance Marketing, and Brand to ensure message-market fit across ads, landing pages, in‑product surfaces, and lifecycle programs.</p></li><li><p>Define success metrics for launches and campaigns, build measurement plans, and use experimentation and analytics to iterate and scale what works.</p></li><li><p>Create <p><span><em>Nota de Perfil:</em> Esta posição foca na gestão técnica de tarefas e entregas do projeto, e <strong>não</strong> na gestão tradicional de pessoas (sem liderança direta de recursos/subordinados)<sup></sup><sup></sup><sup></sup><sup></sup>.</span></p>

Podem ser usadas opções com funcionalidades parecidas.</span></li>
<li><span><strong>Inglês Fluente/Avançado (Mandatório):</strong> Altíssima capacidade de compreensão de escuta (listening) e fala para interagir com múltiplos territórios globais e sotaques diversos<sup></sup>. </span></li>

<p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p>
<p>The Client Success Advisor owns the ongoing relationship for a portfolio of clients. This is a proactive, commercially oriented role responsible for client retention, account growth, tier alignment, and internal delivery accountability.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own and manage a portfolio of high-value client accounts.</li>

<li>Identify and close expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including tier upgrades, development retainers, and additional project work.</li>

<li>Manage difficult client conversations regarding scope, pricing adjustments, and expectation resets.</li>
<li>Coordinate with delivery, support, and development teams on larger engagements.</li>

<li>Act on tier upgrade signals surfaced by the support team. Convert qualified opportunities.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p>

<li>Strong experience with WordPress and web technology services, and their impact on client KPIs (ie. understanding how improving site organization can improve lead generation).</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to identify and close account expansion opportunities.</li>
<li>Comfortable with direct commercial conversations: pricing, scope, renewals, upgrades.</li>
<li>Willingness to assert internally when delivery quality, timelines, or commercial opportunities require intervention.</li>
<li>Ability to work across teams and step into active colleague workflows when the client situation warrants it.</li>
<li>Strong remote communication skills. Able to build trust and manage relationships without in-person interaction.</li>
<li>Comfortable operating in a role with evolving structure. This function is new and the successful candidate will help define it.<br><br></li>

<p><strong>Key Performance Indicators</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Client retention rate within assigned portfolio.</li>
<li>Account expansion revenue against targets.</li>
<li>Tier alignment accuracy across portfolio.</li>
<li>Proactive anticipation of client needs and risks.</li>
<li>Client satisfaction and relationship health scores.</li>
<li>Internal escalation rate and resolution effectiveness.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Working Conditions</strong></p>

<li>Must be available during US business hours.</li>
<li>Travel not anticipated.</li>
</ul>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Delaware</state>
      <skills>Technical Writing, DevOps, Content Creation, CI/CD Pipelines, and AI Agents</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/4898/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> USA
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://superplane.com">https://superplane.com</a>
</p>

<p>SuperPlane is an open source control plane where AI agents and engineers run operations together. We're a team of 10, founded by the creators of Semaphore CI/CD. Our users are DevOps and platform engineers at mid-size to large engineering orgs.</p>
<p>We have a product engineers love, an open source repo with 2K+ stars, and events in the pipeline. What we don't have is someone dedicated to showing the world what SuperPlane can do. We ship fast but our content doesn't keep up. We need someone who can turn what we build into blog posts, tutorials, demos, and videos that resonate with practitioners.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>What you'll own</h2>
<p>This is our first DevRel hire. Your priorities, in order:</p>
<p><strong>1. Video content</strong>: Create screencasts, product walkthroughs, and video demos that show SuperPlane in action. You're comfortable on camera and can produce polished content without a production team.</p>
<p><strong>2. Technical content</strong>: Build working use cases and turn them into blog posts, tutorials, and guides. The typical flow: explore the product, develop a real workflow, write it up, then turn it into a video.</p>
<p><strong>3. Community presence</strong>: Be SuperPlane's voice in our Discord, on Reddit, Hacker News, and relevant DevOps Slack groups. Welcome new users, answer questions, surface interesting discussions, and represent us in a natural, non-salesy way.</p>
<p><strong>4. Events (occasional)</strong>: Represent SuperPlane at conferences or meetups a few times per year.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>What success looks like</h2>
<p>In the first 6 months:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>A consistent publishing cadence: written content and videos shipping weekly</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Content that drives meaningful traffic and signups from organic search and social media shares</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Active, visible presence in community channels where our users hang out</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A growing library of use-case demos that the sales and product teams can reference</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>You're a fit if</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>You have a DevOps or platform engineering background.</strong>&nbsp;You've managed deployments, written CI pipelines, used tools like Terraform or Kubernetes. You could still be an engineer if you wanted to, but you prefer making content.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>You can write working code.</strong>&nbsp;Your tutorials include real, runnable examples. You can spin up a staging environment, write a Lambda function, or put together a working pipeline without needing an engineer to pair with.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>You have deep product intuition.</strong>&nbsp;You pick up a tool and immediately start exploring what's possible. You think in workflows and use cases, not feature lists.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>You're curious and self-directed.</strong>&nbsp;You find the next interesting thing to talk about on your own. You follow the right people, notice opportunities, and don't wait to be told what to write.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>You can produce video content.</strong>&nbsp;Screencasts, walkthroughs, short demos. You don't need a production team. You can do this solo with good tools.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>You use AI tools daily.&nbsp;</strong>Coding agents, LLMs for drafting and review, AI-assisted prototyping. You see these as basic infrastructure for doing good work.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>You're comfortable working async in a distributed team</strong>.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Logistics</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Remote-first.</strong>&nbsp;We support co-working costs if needed.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Timezone:</strong>&nbsp;GMT-5 to GMT+3 (US East Coast through Europe).</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Compensation:</strong>&nbsp;Early-stage startup salary (not FAANG rates) plus significant equity in a company with real traction and experienced founders. If you're looking for a safe big-company paycheck, this isn't it. If you want meaningful ownership in something that's working, let's talk.</p>
<p>We welcome candidates of all backgrounds, genders, orientations, ethnicities, ages, and abilities. If you're looking for a place to do your best work and know your contributions are valued, you'll feel right at home here.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/superplane-devrel-content-creator">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/superplane-devrel-content-creator</a></p>
</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Ljubljana</state>
      <skills>Containers, Linux, Network Protocols, C#, Kubernetes, and Large-scale Distributed Systems</skills>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/5141/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Slovenia
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://bunny.net">http://bunny.net</a>
</p>

<p><strong>Staff&nbsp;Software Engineer (Magic Containers)</strong></p>
<p>Magic Containers is bunny.net’s edge-native platform for running containerized applications. It’s fast, flexible, and free from traditional cloud complexity. No Kubernetes. No YAML jungles. Just a simple, powerful way to deploy and scale apps globally with minimal setup.</p>
<p>It’s already running in production, powering real workloads, and we’re ready to take it further.</p>
<p>As a&nbsp;<strong>Staff Software Engineer</strong>, you’ll help evolve a platform that’s built for developers, with great DX, simple operations, and rock-solid reliability. You’ll work fast, ship often, and have a real voice in shaping the future of how containers run at the edge.</p>
<p>You’re a technical leader who shapes how we build at scale. You solve problems that cross teams, connect technical and business strategy, and make others better through influence, clarity, and mentorship. You set direction, not just follow it. And you leave every system and team stronger than you found them.</p>
<p>You won’t do it alone. You’ll work with people who challenge what’s possible and take pride in doing things well.</p>
<p>If this sounds like the kind of infrastructure you’d want to help others build with, we’d love to hear from you.</p>
<p><strong>What will you do?</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Build and evolve the core of our edge-native container platform -&nbsp;<a href="https://bunny.net/magic-containers/">Magic Containers</a>&nbsp;and shape how developers build at the edge</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Multiply your impact by setting standards, mentoring engineers, and improving both code quality and team-wide knowledge</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Proactively spot opportunities to improve the platform, processes, or developer experience and drive those improvements end-to-end</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Lead cross-team efforts, whether it’s scaling orchestration systems, improving global observability, or driving company-wide migrations and technology shifts</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Align technical direction across teams by collaborating on specs, guiding architecture, and connecting engineering decisions to business goals</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Debug and resolve complex production issues, including those reported by customers</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own outcomes end to end: not just shipping features, but delivering systems that solve real customer problems at scale</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Set a high bar for what great looks like in code quality, system design, and how we support what we build in production</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What will you bring?</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>5+ years of experience with C# or a strong willingness to switch to it</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Deep understanding of containers (cgroups, namespaces, runtimes) and how they work under the hood</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Proven experience building and operating distributed systems across global infrastructure, especially those designed for global scale, low latency, or edge environments</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong Linux systems knowledge and comfort working close to the OS</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Solid grasp of networking fundamentals, including routing protocols, load balancing strategies, and distributed traffic patterns</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Familiarity with time-series or analytical databases like ClickHouse or InfluxDB</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Sharp debugging skills and the ability to diagnose complex production issues</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience leading cross-team or company-wide technical initiatives, guiding architecture, and mentoring engineers</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Understanding of observability best practices: including logging, metrics, and health monitoring for distributed systems</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Clear, thoughtful communication: you write great docs, explain trade-offs, and build alignment</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A customer-first mindset focused on outcomes, long-term reliability, and continuous improvement</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A desire to help others grow and a habit of leading by example in how you write and review code</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What will make us extra happy?</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>High-level understanding of Anycast: how it works, and how it impacts global routing, performance, and failover</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You’ve worked on sandboxing or container security (e.g. gVisor, Kata Containers)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You’ve improved developer experience or infrastructure usability at scale</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Familiarity with message brokers like RabbitMQ or Kafka</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Hands-on with Redis, etcd, or other distributed key-value stores</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You've used bunny.net products or have experience with edge compute/CDN platforms</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You contribute to open source or share knowledge publicly (talks, posts, docs)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You care deeply about developer experience and are thoughtful about the systems you design</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You bring curiosity, care, and energy to your work, and to the people around you</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Not sure if you check every box?</strong></p>
<p>That’s okay. We care more about how you think and what you’ve built than perfect credentials. If this work sounds exciting and you're ready to grow, we want to hear from you.</p>
<p><strong>Where should you be located?</strong></p>
<blockquote>
<p>This job is fully remote from Europe (ideally CET or close time zone) with a flexible schedule, to make our collaboration easier. You’re still free to hop around the world and switch up your scenery whenever you want.</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>What's in it for you?</strong></p>
<p>Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>100% flexible hours -</strong>&nbsp;Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Remote-first by design</strong>&nbsp;- No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our&nbsp;<a href="https://bunnynet.teamtailor.com/locations/bunny-net-headquarters">headquarters</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Performance-based bonuses</strong>&nbsp;- Great work pays off, and we reward impact annually.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Medical, dental, and vision insurance -</strong>&nbsp;Coverage worldwide.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Paid time off -</strong>&nbsp;Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Meeting-free Thursdays</strong>&nbsp;- We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Home office budget -</strong>&nbsp;We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Paid sick leave -</strong>&nbsp;Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Parental leave -</strong>&nbsp;Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Annual fluffle-building&nbsp;</strong>- We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high-fives turn into real ones.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP)</strong>&nbsp;- Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Mental health support -</strong>&nbsp;Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via&nbsp;<a href="http://betterhelp.com/"><strong>BetterHelp.com</strong></a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Wellness budget -</strong>&nbsp;An annual well-being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Educational budget -</strong>&nbsp;€500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work-related or not.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Music on us</strong>&nbsp;<strong>-</strong> Work is better with music. Enjoy a yearly Apple, Spotify, or YouTube Premium subscription on us.</p>
</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bunny-net-staff-software-engineer-magic-containers">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bunny-net-staff-software-engineer-magic-containers</a></p>
</description>

<p><strong>Location:</strong> Remote (Worldwide)<br><strong>Type:</strong> Full-time<br><strong>Compensation:</strong> Base + Uncapped Commission (USD)</p>
<hr>
<h3>About Credit Joy</h3>
<p><strong>Credit Joy</strong> helps people overcome credit challenges and take control of their financial future. We’re a remote-first company serving clients across the United States and are growing our inbound sales team.</p>
<p>We’re looking for <strong>experienced, English-fluent remote sales professionals</strong> who are confident on the phone, disciplined with follow-ups, and motivated by performance-based earnings.</p>
<hr>
<h3>What You’ll Do</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Handle <strong>20–30 inbound calls per day</strong> with qualified leads</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Run structured sales conversations and close consistently</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Average <strong>3+ sales per day</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Follow proven scripts, processes, and CRM workflows</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Work closely with your sales coach to hit weekly and monthly goals</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3>What We’re Looking For</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Sales, call center, or commission-based experience</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Excellent spoken English</strong> (clear, professional, confident)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong closing ability and comfort with phone-based sales</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Reliable high-speed internet (cabled) and quiet workspace</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Laptop or desktop computer (8GB RAM minimum) and headset with mic</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Self-motivated, coachable, and consistent</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Remote sales experience is a plus, but not required</p>
<hr>
<h3>Compensation &amp; Growth</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Base pay + uncapped commission (USD)</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Top performers earn <strong>$3,000–$5,000+ USD/month</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>100% remote, work from anywhere</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ongoing sales training and one-on-one coaching</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Clear path to advancement - we promote from within</p>
</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/credit-joy-remote-sales-representative">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/credit-joy-remote-sales-representative</a></p>
